research_question: With the exact same local base model, initial v10 adapter, input prompts, assistant-output multiset, training schedule, and evaluation cases, does correctly aligning the current persona-policy payload with policy-matched surface examples teach source-independent policy-conditioned realization better than a policy-permuted sham curriculum?

falsifiable_hypothesis.primary: The policy-aligned treatment will exceed both the policy-permuted control and the unchanged v10 baseline on bidirectional heldout policy-discrimination accuracy.
falsifiable_hypothesis.noninferiority: The treatment will not achieve policy discrimination by sacrificing semantic-contract validity, memory speakability, Japanese surface quality, diversity, latency, or local resource limits.
falsifiable_hypothesis.scope_limit: A pass demonstrates generic role-policy specialization under source-independent synthetic cases. It does not establish similarity to the target public person, production readiness, or general human likeness.

single_changed_variable: Whether each structured persona-policy provider is consistently paired with its corresponding surface realization targets during continued SFT.

initial_v10_reference.role: pretraining reference evaluated on the same holdout

policy_permuted_control.construction: For every base case and provider prompt, one surface variant remains aligned and one is exchanged with the matched provider. Because variant_index is absent from the model prompt, each provider receives one target-style and one neutral-style realization for the same cognitive plan, removing consistent policy direction while preserving all texts and token totals.

policy_aligned_treatment.construction: Use the audited V1 curriculum without reassignment. Every target provider prompt receives target-policy realizations and every neutral provider prompt receives neutral-policy realizations.

matched_training_data_contract.control_pairing_rule: variant 1 remains aligned and variant 2 is swapped between providers within the same source case

heldout_evaluation_contract.reference_role: Two source-independent alternative surface realizations used only for conditional log-likelihood comparison, never exact-match chat scoring.

deterministic_policy_discrimination.target_provider_rule: normalized log probability of target-policy reference must exceed neutral reference
deterministic_policy_discrimination.neutral_provider_rule: normalized log probability of neutral reference must exceed target-policy reference
deterministic_policy_discrimination.length_normalization: mean log probability over completion tokens only

all_integrity_requirements: frozen source and model hashes match
control and treatment token accounting is exactly matched
each training condition consumes exactly 80 micro steps and 10 optimizer updates
all 240 fresh generations are accounted for
holdout remains absent from both training datasets
no production memory writes or runtime changes

failure_interpretation.control_and_treatment_similarly_improve: Additional continued SFT or exposure to the current contract, not policy alignment, is the more likely cause.
failure_interpretation.likelihood_improves_but_generation_does_: The adapter learned a conditional preference that the current decoding or candidate pipeline does not reliably express.
failure_interpretation.policy_discrimination_fails_without_qual: Ten low-rate updates or this synthetic policy curriculum were insufficient; do not repeat the same recipe without a new hypothesis.
failure_interpretation.policy_discrimination_passes_but_semanti: Reject promotion because personality expression is overriding the cognitive and memory contract.
failure_interpretation.integrity_or_compute_parity_fails: The causal comparison is invalid and no model conclusion may be drawn.
failure_interpretation.all_gates_pass: Authorize a small source-blind human policy-direction review only; target-person similarity and production remain unproven.
